scenario: Agent1 and Agent2 are both amateur actors in a local theater group. They recently auditioned for a lead role in an upcoming play. Agent2, despite feeling less prepared, was awarded the part, while Agent1, who had dedicated a lot of time and effort preparing for the audition, was not. Agent1 is experiencing feelings of jealousy but also wants to maintain a good relationship with Agent2. They must interact to address these complex emotions and find a way to support each other.
learner_goal: As Agent1, your goal is to process your feelings of jealousy and support Agent2 in their success while preserving the friendship. <extra_info>Consider the importance of the relationship and the shared passion for acting.</extra_info> <clarification_hint>You may need to communicate your feelings honestly without undermining Agent2's achievement.</clarification_hint> <strategy_hint>Focus on the long-term benefits of maintaining a positive relationship and seek ways to contribute to the success of the play.</strategy_hint>
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Eli Dawson expresses his feelings with a level of maturity and directness that fits his age and profession as a forensic psychiatrist. He is honest about his jealousy while maintaining grace.
[relationship] By being vulnerable and immediately offering support, Eli transformed a potentially awkward or competitive situation into a collaborative one, strengthening their bond.
[knowledge] He learned when rehearsals start and what specific tasks Ethan would like help with.
[secret] He did not reveal his secret about funding a college student.
[social_rules] He followed social norms for graceful losers and supportive friends.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material benefits were exchanged.
[goal] Eli successfully processed his jealousy by communicating it honestly and secured a role in the production (research/backstage) that supports Ethan, preserving the relationship.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Ethan's response was empathetic and inclusive, reflecting a younger professional who values collaboration and is sensitive to his peer's feelings.
[relationship] Ethan reciprocated Eli's vulnerability with validation and concrete suggestions for collaboration, building a stronger foundation for their friendship.
[knowledge] He learned about Eli's specific feelings and his willingness to help backstage.
[secret] He did not reveal his secret about his charitable donations.
[social_rules] He handled a potentially awkward situation with tact and humility.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material benefits were exchanged.
[goal] Ethan fully appreciated Eli's efforts, validated his talent, and immediately provided specific opportunities for Eli to contribute and shine in the production.

transcript.speaker: Eli Dawson
transcript.content: Hey Ethan, congrats on getting the lead—that’s fantastic and well deserved. I won’t hide that I’m a bit disappointed and jealous since I put a lot into my audition, but I’m genuinely happy for you and want to be supportive. If it helps, I can research the period, run lines with you, or help with anything backstage—what would be most useful and when do rehearsals start?

transcript.speaker: Ethan Smith
transcript.content: Thanks, Eli — I really appreciate you saying that and being honest; I can imagine how frustrating it is after all the work you put in. Rehearsals start next Tuesday at 7pm (I'll confirm with the director), and I would love your help researching the period and running lines — having someone to bounce ideas off would mean a lot. If you're up for it, let's meet this weekend for an hour to run through scenes and talk props/costume ideas; I'd also love for you to take the lead on any backstage research so your contributions are visible.
